content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 9-12. TYPICAL FLOOR MOUNTED INERTIA REEL INSTALLATION".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows an isometric cutaway view of an aircraft floor structure with an inertia reel mounted beneath the floor panel, illustrating how the reel and its attaching hardware are installed relative to the floor beams and surrounding structure.
